title: Reuse HashMap in coalescing loop to reduce allocations
description: events.rs line 247: HashMap::new() is called on every batch iteration. For rapid-fire state changes, this creates unnecessary allocations. Refactor to clear and reuse a single HashMap across loop iterations, or use a more efficient container (e.g., a small fixed-size array for three types + a computed max). This is a hot loop that fires on every SSE state coalescing event.
